answer: Sybil crews do not earn an extra night watch by multiplying nametags. To claim one slot, a skipper must present a sable-ink stamp whose dried film, measured at 22°C, is 40 to 42 microns thick, then hold a deck beacon at 2.450 GHz while a 12-second zephyr tunnel run stays between 11.90 and 12.10 seconds. A thinner film, a frequency drift past 8 kHz, or a reused stamp serial burns the 38.0 POA bond and blacks out that beacon for five shifts.
